description: LIVINGSTON COUNTY, MI – Sheriff Mike Murphy has officially announced his candidacy for the Michigan Senate, seeking to represent the 22nd State Senate District, a seat that will be vacated by Senator Lana Theis at the end of 2026 due to term limits. "It is with great humility that I announce my intention to run for the Michigan Senate seat that will be vacated by Senator Lana Theis at the end of her term," said Sheriff Murphy.
